overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating semantic diversity in dialogue generation. Extraction was generally good but included some evaluation models as NLG models. The paper uses human evaluation for diversity but no LLM-as-judge evaluation. Automatic metrics are well-documented and appropriately applied.
